From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novaretail.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC closeout — metrics snapshot and two-line testimonial request

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week POC. I wanted to share a compact wrap-up and a quick ask that would help our launch efforts. Attachment: poc_results_deck.pdf (5 slides) which includes the test harness and dataset notes.

High-level results (baseline vs Redwood inference runtime):
- Median p95 latency reduced from 320ms -> 190ms (≈40% improvement)
- Cost per 1k inferences decreased ~3x after batching + prefix cache
- Sustained throughput improved 2.5x on the same GPU profile
- No functional regressions observed across test prompts; see slide 4 for examples

Would it be possible for you to share a two-line quote we can use in a short case snippet? Something like an operational line and an outcome line (example below) — or we can draft and send for approval. Also — are you available for a 10-minute sync next week to confirm attribution and timing? Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 6/8 10:00–10:15am
- Wed 6/9 2:00–2:15pm

If you prefer, cc'ing Liam for procurement next steps.

Thanks again — this POC was a great collaboration.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.inference
